# peakhour_image_transform_commit (Resource)

Commits image transform changes for a domain. Use triggers to control when commits happen.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "peakhour_image_transform_commit" "example" {
  domain = "example.com"
  triggers = {
    revision = "deploy-2026-08-26"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Domain name.

### Optional

- `triggers` (Map of String) Map of values that trigger a commit when changed. Use image transform IDs to commit after changes.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Commit resource identifier.
